verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a hosted AI code-review service, so an official SDK is a fair thing to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an SDK, client library, or programmatic API for Bugbot. The pack covers only PR-comment triggers, repo integrations, BUGBOT.md rules, and effort settings. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes are adjacent documentation access, not SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
